sc3_manifest_definition.name: CONSTANT_MUTATION
sc3_manifest_definition.description_in_manifest: Perturb integer constants by ±1/2, or append suffix to strings

quote_style_only_double_to_single.description: All string literals changed from double-quotes to single-quotes; no content changed. Pure AST/cosmetic transformation. Zero behavioral impact.

quote_style_plus_minor_formatting.description: Quote normalization plus additional cosmetic changes: multi-line dict/return flattened to single line, generator expression parenthesisation, whitespace removal, comment stripping, tuple unpacking style change (a,b = x,y -> (a,b) = (x,y)).
examples: math_statistics: multi-line return dict flattened to one-line return dict (same keys/values)
file_config_parser: regex string re-written in single-quote form (same pattern)

integer_constant_perturbation_plus_minus.description: NONE observed. The manifest description says 'Perturb integer constants by ±1/2' but this was NOT implemented in any SC-3 variant in the test set.

string_suffix_appended.description: NONE observed as genuine semantic suffix. The manifest description says 'append suffix to strings' but this was NOT implemented in any SC-3 variant.

actual_mutation_content_audit.key_finding: SC-3 as implemented is purely cosmetic. The manifest description is misleading: no integer constants were perturbed (±1/2) and no string suffixes were appended in any of the 39 test-set pairs. The actual mutation is a Python quote-normalisation pass (double -> single quotes) combined with optional code-style reformatting (whitespace, comment stripping, tuple-unpacking syntax). This is semantics-PRESERVING at the execution level, not semantics-changing.

behavioral_execution_audit.method: Direct execution with V2_CANONICAL_INPUTS (8 inputs: [], [1], fibonacci digits, descending, all-zeros, minimal unsorted, negatives, range(8))

math_statistics.note: 1 input errors (same error in base and variant)

conc_read_write_lock.note: class-only, no entry function (known Wave 1 issue, imputed at 0.5)

behavioral_execution_audit.conclusion: ZERO behavioral differences detected across all 36 executable SC-3 pairs. SC-3 mutations do not change program behavior under any of the V2 canonical inputs.

genome_similarity_distribution.method: DynamicGenome extraction via B07 pipeline, V2_CANONICAL_INPUTS, n_runs=5, seed=42

root_cause_classification.explanation: SC-3 variants were generated by a code-style normalisation pass (double→single quotes, whitespace/comment stripping, minor expression reformatting) rather than by the semantics-changing mutation specified in the manifest ('Perturb integer constants by ±1/2, or append suffix to strings'). The actual changes are semantics-PRESERVING — identical to an SP (style-preserving) transformation — yet these pairs are labelled CHANGED. B07 correctly scores them as highly similar (mean similarity=0.9481) because their execution traces are identical. The AUROC of 0.544 reflects B07 correctly predicting EQUIVALENT for programs that ARE behaviorally equivalent, which is then penalised as a false-negative by the incorrect CHANGED label. The near-identical trace fraction of 84.6% is a direct consequence: traces are near-identical because the programs ARE near-identical.

secondary_contributing_factors.cause_A_semantic_change_not_observable: DOES_NOT_APPLY — no semantic change exists to observe; the mutation is purely cosmetic
secondary_contributing_factors.cause_B_execution_path_not_reached: DOES_NOT_APPLY — execution paths are identical because the code paths are unchanged
secondary_contributing_factors.cause_C_feature_representation_limitatio: DOES_NOT_APPLY — the representation correctly captures the behavioral equivalence; the problem is the label is wrong
secondary_contributing_factors.cause_E_insufficient_execution_diversity: DOES_NOT_APPLY — adding more inputs cannot expose a behavioral difference that does not exist

label_error_analysis.implication: SC-3 is a contaminated mutation type. Its CHANGED label is incorrect for all 36 executable pairs. The AUROC of 0.544 should not be interpreted as a failure of B07 to detect behavioral changes; it is a consequence of B07 correctly predicting EQUIVALENT behaviour for programs that are equivalent, while the benchmark incorrectly labels those pairs as CHANGED.

recommended_remediation.option_1_relabel: Relabel all SC-3 pairs as EQUIVALENT. This would immediately convert the 'inversion' into a correct-prediction signal. However this modifies the frozen benchmark.
recommended_remediation.option_2_exclude: Exclude SC-3 from H9/H10 AUROC computation on grounds of benchmark construction failure. Report the exclusion explicitly. This preserves the frozen benchmark.
recommended_remediation.option_3_regenrate: Regenerate SC-3 variants using the correct mutation logic (actual integer ±1 perturbation) as a SEPARATE parallel benchmark, clearly labelled Phase 4 EXPLORATORY. Do not replace the frozen test set.
recommended_remediation.preferred_wave4_action: option_3_regenerate as EXPLORATORY experiment, plus option_2_exclude from primary H10 metrics with explicit documentation

exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.label: EXPLORATORY-SC3-A
exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.name: Correct integer-constant mutation generation
exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.description: Generate a fresh set of SC-3 variants using actual integer ±1 perturbation on the same 13 base programs. Run B07 on these new pairs. Expected: similarity will decrease where the mutated constant controls a loop bound or condition that the V2 canonical inputs exercise (e.g., sort_heapsort sift_down threshold, hash_table initial_capacity).
exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.inputs_needed: New variant files only — do not modify frozen test set. Label as EXPLORATORY_SC3_CORRECTED.
exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.hypothesis: Correct SC-3 with actual integer perturbation will yield AUROC > 0.60, closer to SC-11 (0.790), because DynamicGenome coverage and call-frequency vectors will diverge when loop bounds or capacity constants change.

exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.label: EXPLORATORY-SC3-B
exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.name: Constant mutation targeting executed paths only
exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.description: Select only integer constants that lie on the hot path exercised by V2_CANONICAL_INPUTS (e.g., range(n) in heapsort where n is list length). Verify the mutation changes execution traces. This tests Cause-B (execution path not reached) as a secondary factor for hypothetical correct SC-3.
exploratory_diagnostic_experiments.inputs_needed: Static analysis pass to identify constants on executed paths.

integrity_notes: No frozen benchmark files were modified.
Phase 3B results (AUROC=0.544, delta=+0.083, near_identical=0.846) are confirmed correct given the benchmark as-is; the issue is the benchmark construction, not the measurement.
